me55.notes: Checked 2026-10-08 against measured openings: TCGplayer (3,000+ packs) Classic Collection 10.15% (1 in 10), SIR 1 in 21; Wargamer (4,063 packs) Classic 1 in 9.8, SIR 1 in 18; PullRates.com (~800 packs) Classic 1 in 10.5, SIR 1 in 19.8. Profile rates (Classic 10%, SIR 5%) are within that range, so they were kept. Classic Collection (subset me55c) outcome has no rarity filter = any me55c card (31 cards). keepOrder true so the pack reveals in real order. Mew RGB Rare 1/1000 kept as given. The app multiplies hits by HIT_BOOST (src/core/distributions.ts) at opening time; these are the real rates.

swsh12pt5.structure: Real English pack: 10 game cards + 1 Basic Energy (+ code card): 5 Commons, 3 Uncommons, 1 reverse holo, 1 rare-or-better. A Radiant Rare replaces one Common (modelled in the 5th Common slot). Galarian Gallery (swsh12pt5gg) cards replace the reverse holo. Energy omitted (no SWSH energy images in data).
swsh12pt5.notes: Rates from Card Codex per-pack table (community-compiled; method not published), p=1/N. Rare-slot default 'Rare' absorbs the remainder. Reverse-slot default draws uniformly from main-set C/U/R/Rare Holo, which matches Card Codex's reverse C/U/R/RH split (card-count proportional). API rarity 'Rare Ultra' lumps full-art V/VMAX, alt arts and full-art trainers together, so alt arts are not separated. Basic Energy is not in the inventory and is omitted. Radiant Rares are placed in the 5th Common slot (slot index 4) as an independent hit, so a pack can have TG + Radiant + rare-slot hit (some sources say radiants take the reverse slot; we follow the common-replacement reading). Galarian Gallery total is about 34.9% per pack (1 in 2.9), consistent with the commonly cited 1 in 3 to 4. GG 'Rare Holo' cards use API rarity 'Trainer Gallery Rare Holo'. Main-set Rare Secret has 1 card (rare slot only). v2: rebuilt at real English size: 10 game cards (5C/3U/1 reverse/1 rare) + 1 Basic Energy (energy omitted). Same per-pack rates as the 6-slot version.

Reverse-slot default draws uniformly from main-set C/U/R/Rare Holo, which matches Card Codex's reverse C/U/R/RH split (card-count proportional). API rarity 'Rare Ultra' lumps full-art V/VMAX, alt arts and full-art trainers together, so alt arts are not separated. Basic Energy is not in the inventory and is omitted. TG total is about 12.9% per pack (1 in 7.8). v2: rebuilt at real English size: 10 game cards (5C/3U/1 reverse/1 rare) + 1 Basic Energy (energy omitted). Same per-pack rates as the 6-slot version.

swsh8.structure: Fusion Strike: 10 cards = 5 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 reverse holo, 1 rare slot (Rare / Holo / V / VMAX / full art & alt art / rainbow / gold). Plus 1 Basic Energy and a code card (not modelled).
swsh8.notes: Card Codex: Holo 1/5.6, V 1/11.1, Ultra (incl. alt arts) 1/26.0, VMAX 1/26.5, Rainbow 1/91.9, Secret 1/120. Plain Rare remainder (63.5% vs quoted 62.5%). Real English pack = 10 game cards + 1 Basic Energy + code card; the Basic Energy is omitted (no energy images in the data).

cel25.structure: Celebrations: 4 game cards, all holo, no commons/uncommons: 3 main-set non-V holos + 1 hit slot that is a Classic Collection reprint (~1/2.5), a V (~1/2.8), VMAX (~1/13), full-art Professor's Research (1/25), gold Mew (~1/150), else another main-set holo.
cel25.notes: Exact 4-card pack now. Filler slots draw the 17 main-set non-V holos (rarity 'Rare' 12 + 'Rare Holo' 5). Gold Mew cel25-25 is now 'Rare Secret' at 1/150 in the hit slot only. Hit slot default (first, most likely) is Classic Collection; main-set holo takes the remainder (11.9%).

swsh7.structure: Real English pack: 10 game cards + 1 Basic Energy (+ code card): 5 Commons, 3 Uncommons, 1 reverse holo, 1 rare-or-better. No Trainer Gallery; the reverse slot is always a main-set reverse holo. Energy omitted (no SWSH energy images in data).
swsh7.notes: Rates from Card Codex per-pack table (community-compiled; method not published), p=1/N. Rare-slot default 'Rare' absorbs the remainder. Reverse-slot default draws uniformly from main-set C/U/R/Rare Holo, which matches Card Codex's reverse C/U/R/RH split (card-count proportional). API rarity 'Rare Ultra' lumps full-art V/VMAX, alt arts and full-art trainers together, so alt arts are not separated. Basic Energy is not in the inventory and is omitted. Card Codex rare-slot tiers summed to 99%; normalised via the Rare default. v2: rebuilt at real English size: 10 game cards (5C/3U/1 reverse/1 rare) + 1 Basic Energy (energy omitted). Same per-pack rates as the 6-slot version.

swsh45.structure: Shining Fates: 10 game cards = 5 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 reverse-holo slot (replaced by a Shiny Vault card ~33% of packs), 1 rare slot (Rare/Holo/V/VMAX/Amazing/full art/rainbow) + 1 Basic Energy (energy omitted).
swsh45.notes: Card Codex rates as in v1: Shiny Rare 1/4.4, Shiny V 1/19.8, Shiny VMAX 1/25.5, SV gold 1/109.9 (reverse slot); Holo 1/5.6, V 1/9.2, Amazing 1/17.4, VMAX 1/18.4, Ultra 1/30.8, Rainbow 1/84, plain Rare remainder (rare slot). Basic Energy omitted. 18 commons for 5 C slots + reverse.

swsh4.structure: Vivid Voltage: 10 cards = 5 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 reverse holo, 1 rare slot (Rare / Holo / V / Amazing Rare / VMAX / full art / rainbow / gold). Plus 1 Basic Energy and a code card (not modelled).
swsh4.notes: Card Codex: Holo 1/4.6, V 1/7.9, Amazing Rare 1/17.5, VMAX 1/23.3, Ultra 1/25.2, Rainbow 1/78.7, Secret 1/90.1; Amazing Rares kept in the rare slot. Plain Rare remainder (49.2% vs quoted 55.6%; quoted figures sum >100%). Real English pack = 10 game cards + 1 Basic Energy + code card; the Basic Energy is omitted (no energy images in the data).

swsh35.structure: Champion's Path (special set): 10 cards = 5 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 reverse holo, 1 rare slot that is ALWAYS at least Rare Holo (no plain Rares); hits V / VMAX / full art / rainbow / gold replace the holo. Plus 1 Basic Energy and a code card (not modelled).
swsh35.notes: Card Codex: V 1/6.4, Ultra 1/18.6, VMAX 1/28.2, Rainbow 1/63.7 (incl. Charizard VMAX rainbow), Secret 1/75.8 (2 cards: Charizard V gold-ish secret + Suspicious Food Tin). Rare Holo is the remainder (72.6% vs quoted 71.4%). Reverse energy not modelled (no energy cards in inventory). Real English pack = 10 game cards + 1 Basic Energy + code card; the Basic Energy is omitted (no energy images in the data).

sm12.structure: Cosmic Eclipse: 10 cards = 5 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 reverse holo slot (replaced by a Character Rare ~1 in 10 packs), 1 rare slot (Rare / Holo / GX & Tag Team GX / full art / rainbow / gold). Plus 1 Basic Energy and a code card (not modelled).
sm12.notes: Card Codex: Character Rare 1/10 (reverse slot), Holo 1/6.9, GX incl. Tag Team 1/7.8, Ultra 1/26.2, Rainbow 1/71.4, Secret (gold) 1/111.1; plain Rare remainder (66.6%, matches quoted 66.7%). CAVEAT: the data source labels both the 12 Character Rares (sm12 #237-248) and the 9 gold secrets (#263-271) as 'Rare Secret', so with rarity-string pools the reverse-slot (slot 9) 10% outcome draws a gold ~9/21 of the time (effective gold ~1/20 instead of 1/111). To be exact, relabel #237-248 (e.g. rarityRaw 'Character Rare' or a subset) in the manifest and point the slot-9 outcome at it. Also note '143a' (Togepi & Cleffa & Igglybuff-GX alt, a promo variant) is labelled 'Rare Ultra' and joins that pool. Real English pack = 10 game cards + 1 Basic Energy + code card; the Basic Energy is omitted (no energy images in the data). Character Rares (237–248) re-tagged 'Character Rare' by the downloader.

sm115.structure: Hidden Fates: 10 game cards = 5 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 reverse-holo slot (replaced by a Shiny Vault card ~39% of packs), 1 rare slot (Rare / Holo / GX / full art / rainbow) + 1 Basic Energy (energy omitted).
sm115.notes: Shiny Vault rates (cardzard 2,350-pack sample): baby shiny 1/4, Shiny GX 1/9, SV full-art trainer 1/73, gold 1/57 in the reverse slot. Main rare slot partly estimated: GX 28%, full art 8%, rainbow 3%, Holo 18%, Rare remainder. Basic Energy omitted. 18 commons for 5 C slots + reverse.

sm9.structure: Team Up: 10 cards = 5 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 reverse holo, 1 rare slot (Rare / Holo / GX / Prism Star / full art / rainbow / gold). Plus 1 Basic Energy and a code card (not modelled).
sm9.notes: Card Codex rates: Holo 1/6, GX 1/10, Prism Star 1/18, Ultra (full art GX + full art trainers) 1/24, Rainbow 1/60, Secret (gold items) 1/120. Plain Rare is the remainder (61% vs quoted 66.7%; quoted figures sum >100%). Prism Stars kept in the rare slot; reverse slot draws any main-set C/U/R/Holo. Real English pack = 10 game cards + 1 Basic Energy + code card; the Basic Energy is omitted (no energy images in the data).

xy12.structure: Real English pack: 10 game cards + 1 Basic Energy (energy omitted: no energy images in the data) = 5 commons, 3 uncommons (secret rares 109-113 are on the uncommon sheet), 1 reverse holo (BREAK ~1 in 18), 1 rare slot (Rare, Rare Holo, Pokémon-EX ~1 in 8.2, full art ~1 in 15).
xy12.notes: Rates: EX 1/8.2, full art 1/15, BREAK 1/18 (reverse slot), secret rare 1/8.1 in the 3rd uncommon slot. Secrets were printed on the uncommon sheet, so a pack can have a secret plus an EX. The plain Rare Holo rate of 0.2 is an era-typical estimate. Mega EX cards are labeled 'Rare Holo EX' in the data. The Basic Energy is omitted.

ex7.structure: Real English pack: 9 cards = 5 commons, 2 uncommons, 1 reverse holo, 1 rare slot (non-holo rare, holo, ex ~1 in 12, Gold Star ~1 in 72, secret rare ~1 in 108). No basic energy in the set.
ex7.notes: Gold Stars Mudkip/Torchic/Treecko (107-109) are correctly 'Rare Holo Star'; secrets Charmeleon (110) and Here Comes Team Rocket! (111) are correctly 'Rare Secret'. Holo = 1/3 - 1/12 - 1/72 - 1/108 (~0.2269). Reverse slot weighted by card count over C/U/R/RH. Special energies (94-95) are Uncommon.

ex6.structure: Real English pack: 9 cards = 5 commons, 2 uncommons, 1 reverse holo, 1 rare slot (non-holo rare, holo ~2 in 9, ex ~1 in 12, secret rare ~1 in 36). No basic energy in the set.
ex6.notes: Secret rares 113-116 (Charmander, Articuno/Moltres/Zapdos ex) are correctly 'Rare Secret'. Holo = 1/3 - 1/12 - 1/36 = 2/9. Reverse slot weighted by card count over C/U/R/RH (no reverse ex/secrets). Data lists two 'Mr. Mime ex' entries (ex6-110 and ex6-111), both 'Rare Holo EX' - likely a naming error in the source data, harmless for rarity.

ex1.structure: Real English pack: 9 cards = 4 commons, 2 uncommons, 1 rare (always), 1 reverse holo (any card, basic energy included), 1 premium slot (ex ~1 in 6, holo rare ~1 in 6, basic energy ~1 in 3, otherwise a common).
ex1.notes: The 6 basic energies (104-109) are tagged 'Common' in the data, so the premium slot's 1/3 energy + 1/3 common are merged into one 2/3 Common outcome (energy can't be targeted separately by rarity); energies still show up through the Common pools. ex 1/6 per Zorloth/Card Codex; holo 1/6 (same as ex). Holo+ex share the premium slot; the rare slot is always a non-holo Rare. Some early print runs reportedly had fewer holos (2-3/box) - not modeled.

ecard3.structure: Real English pack: 9 cards = 5 commons, 2 uncommons, 1 reverse-holo slot (any main-set card), 1 rare slot (non-holo rare, H-numbered holo rare ~1 in 3.4 packs, or Crystal Pokémon secret rare 145-150 ~1 in 18). No basic energy in the set.
ecard3.notes: There are no official odds; the H-holo (~1/3.4) and Crystal (~1/18) rates are community estimates. The data labels Crystals 145-150 'Rare Secret' and H1-H32 'Rare Holo', which is correct. Reverse-holo Crystals are not modeled, to keep exactly one hit per pack. The reverse slot's 60/30/10 Common/Uncommon/Rare split is an estimate.

ecard2.structure: Real English pack: 9 cards = 4 commons, 2 uncommons, 1 rare (always), 1 reverse holo, 1 premium slot (H-numbered holo ~11 in 36, Crystal Pokémon secret rare ~1 in 36, otherwise a common). No basic energy in the set.
ecard2.notes: Crystals Kingdra/Lugia/Nidoking (148-150) are correctly 'Rare Secret'; H1-H32 holos are correctly 'Rare Holo'. Crystal 1/36 (~1 per box) + holo 11/36 = 1/3 premium. Reverse slot weighted by card count over main-set C/U/R (H-holos have no reverse versions in the data; reverse Crystals not modeled).

ecard1.structure: Real English pack: 9 cards = 4 commons, 2 uncommons, 1 rare (always), 1 reverse holo (any non-basic-energy card, equal odds per card), 1 premium slot (holo rare ~1 in 3, otherwise a common). A pack can hold holo + rare + reverse rare.
ecard1.notes: Holo rare does not replace the rare (it replaces a common). Reverse slot weighted by card count (C 49, U 38, R 40, RH 32 of 159; community says rarity has no effect on reverse odds). Basic energies 160-165 (rarity "") are NOT modeled: no pack-structure source lists them in Expedition boosters (they appear to come from theme decks) and they had no reverse versions - so rarity "" is not obtainable for ecard1.

base6.structure: Real English pack: 11 cards = 6 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 reverse holo (any of the 110 cards, fireworks pattern), 1 rare (holo ~1 in 3, otherwise non-holo rare). No basic energy in the set.
base6.notes: All 110 reverse holos were printed on one sheet at equal rates, so the reverse slot is weighted by card count (C 36, U 36, R 19, RH 19 of 110). Commons/uncommons really came as 9 consecutive cards from a shared C/U sheet (avg ~3 uncommons); modeled as a fixed 6C+3U. No basic energies (100/101 are special Potion/Full Heal Energy, Uncommon).

neo4.structure: Real English pack: 11 cards = 7 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 rare slot (non-holo rare, holo rare ~9 per 36-pack box, or Shining Pokémon ~3 per box). No reverse holos; Neo Destiny has no basic energy cards in the set.
neo4.notes: Rates come from community box openings: 9 holos and 3 Shinings per 36-pack box. The Shining is in the rare slot, so a pack never has both a holo and a Shining. Some unlimited 'error' boxes put an extra Shining in a common slot (~1 in 24 packs); that is deliberately not modeled.

neo3.structure: Real English pack: 11 cards = 7 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 rare slot (non-holo rare, holo ~1 in 4, or Shining Pokémon ~1 in 12). No basic energy in the set.
neo3.notes: Shining Gyarados/Magikarp (65-66, correctly 'Rare Shining' in the data) at 1/12 (~3 per 36-pack box) share the rare slot with holos; holo = 1/3 - 1/12 = 1/4 so total premium stays 1/3.

neo2.structure: Real English pack: 11 cards = 7 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 rare (holo ~1 in 3, otherwise non-holo rare). No basic energy in the set.
neo2.notes: Standard WOTC 1/3 holo rate. Neo Discovery has no basic energy cards.

neo1.structure: Neo Genesis (unlimited): 11 game cards = 6 commons, 1 basic energy (printed in the set), 3 uncommons, 1 rare slot (Rare Holo ~1 in 3, else Rare).
neo1.notes: Structure kept 1:1 (Card Codex: 6 C, 3 U, 1 Energy, Rare 66.7% / Holo 33.3%).

gym2.structure: Real English unlimited pack: 11 cards = 1 basic energy, 6 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 rare (holo ~1 in 3, otherwise non-holo rare).
gym2.notes: Basic energies 127-132 have rarity "" in the data; 1 energy slot. 1st Edition odds are the same structure.

gym1.structure: Real English unlimited pack: 11 cards = 7 common-sheet cards (commons plus the set's basic energy cards), 3 uncommons, 1 rare (holo ~1 in 3 packs, otherwise non-holo).
gym1.notes: Uses the standard vintage 1-in-3 holo rate. The set's 6 basic energies have no rarity in the data (rarity "") and share 2 common-sheet slots at 50% each, about 1 energy per pack. That energy split is an estimate.

base5.structure: Team Rocket (unlimited): 11 game cards = 7 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 rare slot (Rare Holo ~1 in 3, else Rare); the secret Dark Raichu (83/82) very rarely takes the holo's place. No basic energy.
base5.notes: Structure kept 1:1. Dark Raichu has no published rate: estimated 1 in 100 packs, taken out of the holo share (holo 32.3%). Commons include the set's special energies/trainers as tagged in the data (24 commons for 7 slots).

base4.structure: Real English pack: 11 cards = 2 basic energies, 5 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 rare (holo ~1 in 3 packs, otherwise non-holo rare). No reverse holos.
base4.notes: Base Set 2's 6 basic energies (125-130) have no rarity in the data (rarity ""); 2 energy slots draw from them. Holo rate 1/3 is the WOTC back-of-pack 'premium' rate.

base3.structure: Unlimited Fossil: 11 game cards = 7 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 rare slot (Rare Holo ~1 in 3, else Rare). No energy.
base3.notes: Real structure kept 1:1 (16 commons in pool for 7 slots).

base2.structure: Unlimited Jungle: 11 game cards = 7 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 rare slot (Rare Holo ~1 in 3, else Rare). No energy in Jungle packs.
base2.notes: Real structure kept 1:1 (16 commons in pool for 7 slots).

base1.structure: Unlimited Base Set: 11 game cards = 5 commons, 2 basic energies (printed in the set), 3 uncommons, 1 rare slot (Rare Holo ~1 in 3, else non-holo Rare). Exactly one rare per pack.
base1.notes: Real structure kept 1:1. Real packs could contain two identical energies; the app forbids repeats, so the 2 energy slots draw 2 different energies from the 6 basic energies (rarity '').
